summary_bullets: Port version bump and CHANGELOG logic from eight bash scripts into stdlib-only python/version_bump.py and python/changelog.py (Phase 2 strangler-fig; live path unchanged).
Extend python/git.py and python/config.py with injectable git primitives and bump/changelog constants shared by the new modules.

Add StubRunner and bash-parity pytest coverage (classify, apply, check-bump pre, drop helpers, changelog transforms, auto-resolve) plus unit tests for branch-guard, same-version race, and origin regression correction.
commit_message:
Port ship-pr Phase 2 version bump and changelog to Python

Add version_bump.py and changelog.py with bash-parity tests, extending git.py and config.py. Strangler-fig only: no live /implement wiring and no .sh deletions.
